issue.title: Add Initials Indicator to Drafting Page Header
issue.body: When multiple accounts are logged in on a device, users need a persistent, at-a-glance way to see which account is currently active without opening a menu. This ticket adds a conditionally visible initials indicator to the drafting page header that doubles as the entry point for the account switcher panel. ## Functional Requirements ### Header Layout - The drafting page header currently has a back arrow on the left and a sync icon on the right. - Add an initials indicator icon to the right of the sync icon, making two icons on the right side of the header. ### Initials Indicator - Display the active account's first and last initials inside a small circle. - Only render the indicator when two or more accounts are logged in on the device; single-account users see no change to the header. - Tapping the indicator opens the account switcher panel (see #84). > **Note:** The initials circle is a custom UI element, not a Lucide icon. Style to match the app's existing avatar/badge conventions.
